scripts.text:
[Killer]
Wh-what have
you done to me?!
C-can't... move!
scripts.translation:
[杀手]
你...你对我做了什么？！
我...动不了！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Oh? I didn't expect
you to be able to cast
Close Confine so soon!
Amazing, just amazing!
Now, this is a good chance
for you to master the skill...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
哦？没想到你能这么快就使出紧密的约束！
太棒了，简直太棒了！
现在，这是你掌握这项技能的好机会...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Now pay attention.
I want you to practice
predicting your opponent's
movement intent on this killer.
You should be able to see which way he plans to move by his aura.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
现在集中注意力。
我要你在这个杀手身上练习预判对手的移动意图。
你应该能通过他的灵气看出他打算往哪个方向移动。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
If he plans to move to left,
his aura will be white. If he
moves to the right, it will be
yellow. If he intends to go
backward, it will be pale red.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
如果他打算向左移动，他的灵气会是白色的。如果他向右移动，灵气会是黄色的。如果他打算后退，灵气会是淡红色的。

scripts.text: Block him to the Left
scripts.translation: 向左拦截

scripts.text: Block him to the Right
scripts.translation: 向右拦截

scripts.text: Block his Retreat
scripts.translation: 拦截其撤退

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe killer remains
unable to move and looks
incredibly confused! Right
now, you're using the Close
Confine skill perfectly!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF杀手依然无法移动，看起来非常困惑！
此刻，你完美地使用了紧密的约束！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait--!
For some reason,
you sense that's not
the direction the killer
is moving at this moment.
You naturally correct yourself.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等等——！
不知为何，你感觉到杀手此刻并没有朝那个方向移动。
你本能地修正了自己的判断。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou successfully
retrieved the priceless
skill book written by the
legendary Chae Takbae.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你成功取回了传奇人物蔡德培所写的珍贵技能书。^000000

scripts.text:
[Killer]
Grrrrr...
S-still...
C-can't... Move!
scripts.translation:
[杀手]
嘎嘎嘎...
还...还是...
动...不了！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hm? Ah, amnesia as
resulting from transcending,
eh? Then I will teach you the
Close Confine skill once again.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
嗯？啊，是因为超越导致的失忆症吗？
那么，我再教你一次紧密的约束。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
A Stalker, eh?
Make sure that you
use your abilities to
malign foes that deserve
to be stalked. Best of
luck to you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
神行太保，是吗？
请务必利用你的能力，去追踪那些值得被追踪的敌人。
祝你好运，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
H-how did you find this
place? I thought this panic
room was supposed to be
impenetrable, even by Rogues!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
你...你是怎么找到这个地方的？
我以为这个密室连流氓都进不来！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
This can't be good!
It will only be a matter of
time before they find me...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
这下糟了！
他们迟早会找到我的...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Wh-who are you,
and how did you get
in here? Identify yourself!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
你...你是谁？
你是怎么进来的？报上名来！

scripts.text: I don't mean you any harm!
scripts.translation: 我没有恶意！

scripts.text: Give us what we want!
scripts.translation: 交出我们要的东西！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
No...?
Then... Then
why have you come?
It is no accident that
you have found me.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
没有恶意？
那么...那你为什么来这里？
你能找到我，绝非偶然。

scripts.text: I came to help you.
scripts.translation: 我是来帮你的

scripts.text: Oh, actually, I wasn't looking for you.
scripts.translation: 其实，我并不是在找你

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hmm... Well, I suppose
I can trust a fellow Stalker
with my predictament. Honor
among thieves and all that.
Alright. Have you ever heard
the legend of Chae Takbae?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
嗯...好吧，我想我可以信任同为神行太保的你。
毕竟，盗贼之间也有义气。
那么，你听说过蔡德培的传说吗？

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hmm... Well, I suppose
I can trust a fellow Rogue
with my predictament. Honor
among thieves and all that.
Alright. Have you ever heard
the legend of Chae Takbae?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
嗯...好吧，我想我可以信任同为流氓的你。
毕竟，盗贼之间也有义气。
那么，你听说过蔡德培的传说吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
100 years ago, Chae Takbae
was the very first person to
transcend his limits. He was
also the very person to choose
a different path, rather than the job order he previously had.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
100年前，蔡德培是第一个超越极限的人。
他也是第一个选择不同道路，而非遵循原有职业顺序的人。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
He was originally a Monk,
but after transcending, he
somehow became a Stalker.
Retaining his knowledge of
the Monk's Root skill, he adapted it for the purposes of the Rogues.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
他原本是武僧，但在超越之后，不知为何变成了神行太保。
他保留了武僧的真剑百破道技能知识，并将其改编用于流氓。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Chae Takbae recorded the
fundamentals for this new
Rogue skill in a book that
I was fortunate enough to
obtain. But as soon as I got
it, the blackmailing begain...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
蔡德培将这项新流氓技能的基础记录在一本书中，我有幸获得了它。但就在我拿到书的那一刻，勒索就开始了...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
There are unscrupulous
parties that will use any
means to take the book away
from me. I can understand, as
my sons and I have learned new
skills from Takbae's writings.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
有一些不择手段的人，会不惜一切代价从我手中夺走这本书。
我理解他们的动机，因为我和我的儿子们已经从德培的著作中学到了新技能。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
However, I am running
out of time and those men
will inevitably find me.
Will you help me save
myself and my sons?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
然而，我的时间不多了，那些人迟早会找到我。
你愿意帮我救我和我儿子们吗？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text: Sorry, but I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Oh, thank you so much!
Listen, I can't risk being
found, so would you take
this letter to my youngest
son, ^FF0000Louis Greg^000000? Hurry,
there's not much time left!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
哦，太感谢你了！
听着，我不能冒险被找到，所以你能把这封信带给我最小的儿子，^FF0000路易斯·格雷格^000000吗？快一点，时间不多了！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
I... I see.
But please realize
that, if not you, who
can I trust to help me?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
我...我明白了。
但请想想，如果不是你，我还能信任谁来帮我呢？

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Then you would know the
value of the skill book he has
written that I now possess.
However, I'm hounded by men
who will do anything to get it.
Would you please help me?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
那么你应该知道，他写的那本技能书的价值，而我现在正持有它。
然而，我被那些不惜一切代价想要得到它的人追赶。
你能帮我吗？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text: Sorry, but I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Oh, thank you so much!
Listen, I can't risk being
found, so would you take
this letter to my youngest
son, ^FF0000Louis Greg^000000? Hurry,
there's not much time left!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
哦，太感谢你了！
听着，我不能冒险被找到，所以你能把这封信带给我最小的儿子，^FF0000路易斯·格雷格^000000吗？快一点，时间不多了！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
I... I see.
But please realize
that, if not you, who
can I trust to help me?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
我...我明白了。
但请想想，如果不是你，我还能信任谁来帮我呢？

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hm...?
That seems unlikely, but
I suppose I better give you
the benefit of the doubt.
Well then, I hope that you
can find your way out of here.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
嗯...？
这似乎不太可能，但我想我还是应该给你一点信任。
那么，我希望你能找到出路离开这里。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
I see. So be it.
I'll show you the skill
that you covet so much...
^FF0000Close Confine^000000!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
我明白了。那就这样吧。
我会展示你如此渴望的技能...
^FF0000紧密的约束^000000！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hmpf. Now you are
helpless, allowing
me to do this: ^FF0000Back Stab^000000!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
哼。现在你毫无还手之力，让我来做这件事：^FF0000背刺^000000！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Now get out of here.
Never show your greedy
face in front of me again.
And just be happy that
I haven't killed you!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
现在滚出去。
永远不要再让我看到你这贪婪的脸。
庆幸我没有杀了你吧！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
We're running out of
time... Please bring this
letter to my youngest son,
^FF0000Louis^000000, as soon as you can!
You can find him in the Rogue
Guild near ^FF0000Hollgrehenn Junior^000000.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
我们的时间不多了...
请尽快把这封信带给我最小的儿子，^FF0000路易斯^000000！
你可以在^FF0000小霍尔格雷恩^000000附近的流氓公会找到他。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Louis sent you to find
^FF0000Thor^000000? He's in the Rogue
Guild near ^FF0000Hermanthorn Jr.^000000,
isn't he? I'm sorry that you
have to visit my sons one by
one... I know it's impractical.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
路易斯派你来找^FF0000索尔^000000？
他在^FF0000小赫曼索恩^000000附近的流氓公会，对吧？很抱歉让你不得不逐个拜访我的儿子们...
我知道这很不方便。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Ah, looking for ^FF0000Jay^000000, eh?
He's near ^FF0000Antonio Jr.^000000 here
in the Rogue Guild. Or at
least, he's usually there.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
啊，在找^FF0000杰伊^000000，是吗？
他就在^FF0000小安东尼奥^000000附近的流氓公会。
至少，他通常都在那里。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Oh, you're back!
And you've brought
a letter from Jay.
Good, good, let me
read what he has to say...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
哦，你回来了！
而且你带来了杰伊的信。
很好，很好，让我看看他说了什么...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Ah, great news! He's
contacted the Rogue Guild
to request extra protection
and to alert their guard. I can
finally relax just a little now. No one messes with Rogues.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
太好了！他联系了流氓公会，请求加强安保并通知卫兵。
我终于可以稍微放松一下了。
没人敢惹流氓。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Thank you very much for
your help. I would be in
hiding forever if it weren't
for you. In return, let me
offer you the chance to learn
Chae Takbae's secret skill.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
非常感谢你的帮助。
如果没有你，我可能永远都要躲藏起来了。
作为回报，让我给你一次学习蔡德培秘密技能的机会。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Please speak to ^FF0000Thor^000000
and tell him that I've
permitted you to learn
the skill I have taught
all of my sons. He'll
comply, I'm sure of it.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
请去和^FF0000索尔^000000对话，告诉他我允许你学习我教给所有儿子的技能。
我相信他会答应的。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Please ask Thor to teach
you Chae Takbae's secret
Rogue skill. Understand that
I can't teach you this skill
with the equipment here in
this sloven panic room.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
请让索尔教你蔡德培的秘密流氓技能。
请理解，我无法在这个杂乱无章的房间里教你这个技能。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hm...? Aren't you
supposed to be in the
middle of training to learn
that skill? Please speak to
Thor and complete your training.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
嗯...？你不应该正在训练学习那个技能吗？
请去和索尔对话，完成你的训练。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
You've completed the
training? Ah, that's quite
exceptional. However, you
should speak to Thor first...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
你完成了训练？
啊，这相当出色。
不过，你应该先和索尔对话...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Oh, you've come back!
I hear that you've completed
the training and are ready
to hear about the applications
for the Close Confine skill.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
哦，你回来了！
我听说你已经完成了训练，准备听取关于紧密的约束技能的应用说明了。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Wah! What th--?!
Stop! P-please, stop
that man! We can't let
him steal that book!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
哇！什...什么？！
住手！请...请阻止那个男子！我们不能让他偷走那本书！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
That man just stole the
Close Confine skill book!
Please! Don't let him get
away! That book is priceless!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
那个男子刚刚偷走了紧密的约束技能书！
请！别让他逃了！
那本书是无价的！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou returned the
skill book written by
Chae Takbae to Haijara.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你将蔡德培写的技能书归还给了海哈拉。^000000

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Thanks so much for your
assistance. Now, if you'd
like to know some detailed
information about Close
Confine, I can tell you more
about the skill if you like.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
非常感谢你的协助。
现在，如果你想知道关于紧密的约束的详细信息，我可以为你详细介绍这个技能。

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
As you must know,
Close Confine immobilizes
an enemy that is very close
to you. However, there are
a few nuances regarding its
use on players or monsters.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
如你所知，紧密的约束会定住离你很近的敌人。
不过，在对玩家或魔物使用时有一些细微差别。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Now, Close Confine is
similar to the Monk's skill,
Root, but it only inhibits the
enemy's movement, not
its attack capabilities.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
现在，紧密的约束类似于武僧的技能真剑百破道，但它只限制敌人的移动，而不限制其攻击能力。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
With the exception of
Back Stab, which we can
only use once during Close
Confine's duration, we can
use any skill during the
Close Confine status.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
除了背刺在紧密的约束持续期间只能使用一次之外，我们可以在紧密的约束状态下使用任何技能。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Enemies affected by
Close Confine can escape
by using Fly Wing, Butterfly
Wings, or the Teleport or
Hiding skills. However, only
Hiding is active during WoE.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
受到紧密的约束影响的敌人可以通过使用苍蝇翅膀、蝴蝶翅膀，或瞬间移动或隐匿技能来逃脱。
不过，在攻城战中只有隐匿有效。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Therefore, Close Confine
can be a very useful skill
during Guild War sieges, given
that the target doesn't use the
the Hiding skill to get away.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
因此，在攻城战中，紧密的约束可以是一个非常有用的技能，前提是目标不使用隐匿技能逃跑。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
With the exception of Boss
monsters, Close Confine
will immobilize monsters for
10 seconds, giving Rogues
new possibilities when
hunting in a party.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
除了Boss魔物外，紧密的约束会将魔物定住10秒，为流氓在队伍狩猎中提供新的可能性。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Well, that's all I can tell
you about Close Confine.
I hope that you can learn
more about this skill through
practice, and that you become as great a legend as Chae Takbae.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
好了，这就是我能告诉你的关于紧密的约束的一切。
我希望你能通过练习更多地了解这个技能，并成为像蔡德培一样伟大的传奇。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
All right then...
I hope that you can
learn more about Close
Confine through diligent
practice. Good luck, and
thanks again for your help.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
那么...
我希望你能通过勤奋的练习更多地了解紧密的约束。
祝你好运，再次感谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Thank you for helping
me protect this priceless
skill book. I hope that the
next time we meet, we'll be
comrades on the battlefield...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
谢谢你帮我保护这本无价的技能书。
我希望下次我们见面时，我们能在战场上成为同志...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
H-how did you find this
place? I thought this panic
room was supposed to be
impenetrable, even by Rogues!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
你...你是怎么找到这个地方的？
我以为这个密室连流氓都进不来！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
This can't be good!
It will only be a matter of
time before they find me...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
这下糟了！
他们迟早会找到我的...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Please...
Find me a Stalker
or a Rogue that I can
trust and send him to
help me! I don't have 
much time left...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
拜托了...
请帮我找一位我信任的神行太保或流氓，让他来帮我！
我剩下的时间不多了...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
My father just...
He just vanished!
He was teaching me and
my brothers a new skill,
but lately he began acting
paranoid for some reason...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
我父亲刚刚...
他就这样消失了！
他原本正在教我和兄弟们一项新技能，但最近他不知为何变得有些偏执...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Maybe he went into hiding?
I know there's a hidden panic
room in the Rogue Guild, but
even I don't know where to find
it. I hope everything's okay...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
也许他躲起来了？
我知道流氓公会里有一个隐藏的密室，但我也不知道在哪里。
希望他没事...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Father did warn that
people might come after us
if they're learned about the
new skill we were learning.
Maybe he went into hiding in
the Rogue Guild's panic room...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
父亲曾警告过，如果有人得知了我们正在学习的新技能，可能会找上门来。
也许他躲进了流氓公会的密室...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
What's this...?
A letter from my
father? Oh, he must
be alright! Quick, let
me read it right away!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
这是什么...？
父亲的信？
噢，他应该没事！
快，让我马上读一下！

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Oh no, he may be safe for
now, but father is being hunted
by some dangerous people? My
brother Thor will want to know
about this. Let me write him
a letter really quickly...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
噢不，他现在可能安全，但父亲正被一些危险的人追捕？
我哥哥索尔会想知道这件事的。让我赶紧给他写封信...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
I know that I'm in no
position to ask any favors,
but I guess my father must
trust you. Please, would you
take my letter and deliver it
to my older brother, Thor?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
我知道我没有资格提出这样的请求，但我父亲一定很信任你。
拜托，你能收下这封信，并把它交给我哥哥索尔吗？

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
You can find Thor
next to Hermanthorn Jr.
inside the Rogue Guild.
I'd really appreciate it if
you could help my family.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
你可以在流氓公会里，小赫曼索恩旁边找到索尔。
如果你能帮帮我家人，我会非常感激的。

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
My elder brother, ^FF0000Thor^000000,
must know about this right
away! Please bring him this
letter for me. He should be
near ^FF0000Hermanthorn Jr.^000000 here
inside the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
我的哥哥，^FF0000索尔^000000，必须马上知道这件事！
请把这封信带给他。
他应该就在流氓公会里，^FF0000小赫曼索恩^000000旁边。

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
You're looking for my
brother, Jay? He's usually
hanging out here in the
Rogue Guild with Antonio Jr.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
你在找我哥哥杰伊？
他通常都在流氓公会里，和小安东尼奥混在一起。

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
If you need to speak
to my father, he's still
probably in the hidden panic
room inside the Rogue Guild.
I still don't know where that
place could possibly be...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
如果你需要和我父亲对话，他可能还在流氓公会里那个隐藏的密室中。
我到现在都不知道那个地方到底在哪里...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
You want to learn the
secret Rogue skill? Oh,
you should probably talk
to ^FF0000Thor^000000 about that. I...
I'm really bad at explaining
things to people. Really bad.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
你想学习流氓的秘密技能？噢，你最好去和^FF0000索尔^000000谈谈。
我...我真的很不擅长向别人解释事情。真的不擅长。

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Hm? You're in the middle
of learning the secret Rogue
skill, aren't you? Ooh, then
you're not supposed to be here
just yet. Please go back and
talk to ^FF0000Thor^000000 again, okay?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
嗯？你正在学习流氓的秘密技能，对吧？
噢，那你现在还不应该在这里。
请回去再和^FF0000索尔^000000谈谈，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Oh, oh!
You're done with
the training? Ah,
then you need to
talk to Thor again!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
噢，噢！
你训练完了？
啊，那你需要再去找索尔谈谈！

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
You wanted to learn
more about Close Confine?
Ugh, then you better speak
to my father. I just learned
that skill myself, you know.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
你想了解更多关于紧密的约束？
唉，那你最好去和我父亲谈谈。
我自己也才刚学会这个技能，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
I just heard from my
brothers that Chae Takbae
developed Close Confine
as a way to brutally beat his
enemies, keeping them from
running away. Is that true?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
我刚从兄弟们那里听说，蔡德培开发紧密的约束是为了残酷地击败敌人，让他们无法逃跑。
这是真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Wow, you're really
great! I wish I were
as powerful as you.
I hate being a kid!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
哇，你真的很厉害！
我希望我也能像你一样强大。
我讨厌当小孩！

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Why'd I become a Rogue?
I guess I just like being
sneaky. That, and being
moral and law abiding is
just too tough, you know?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
我为什么成为流氓？
我想我只是喜欢偷偷摸摸的感觉。
而且，保持道德和遵纪守法实在太难了，你知道的？

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Where did father go?
I hope those weird men
didn't get to him. With
any luck, he's hidden in
the panic room, but still...
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
父亲去哪里了？
我希望那些怪人没有抓到他。
运气好的话，他躲在密室里，但还是...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Hm... My father might
be hiding in the panic
room. I've never been able
to find it, but Markie says
that the entrance is cleverly
hidden to her left. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
嗯...我父亲可能躲在密室里。
我一直没找到它，但马基说入口巧妙地隐藏在她左边。
嗯嗯...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Are you looking for
my little brother, ^FF0000Louis^000000?
Oh, he's always hanging
around that ^FF0000Hollgrehenn Jr.^000000
here in the Rogue Guild.
What did you need him for?
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
你在找我弟弟^FF0000路易斯^000000吗？
哦，他总是在流氓公会里和这里的^FF0000小霍尔格雷恩^000000混在一起。
你找他有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
What's this you're
giving me? A letter
from Louis? Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
你给我的这是什么？
路易斯的信件？让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Oh God, father's in
serious trouble! I better
tell my older brother, Jay,
right away! Quick, find ^FF0000Jay^000000
next to ^FF0000Antonio Jr.^000000 here in
the guild! P-please hurry!
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
天哪，父亲陷入大麻烦了！
我得马上告诉我的哥哥杰伊！
快，去公会里找^FF0000杰伊^000000，他就在^FF0000小安东尼奥^000000旁边！
请...请快点！

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
You can find Jay hanging
out with Antonio Jr. here
inside the Rogue Guild. 
Please bring him the letter
I've written as soon as possible!
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
你可以在流氓公会里找到杰伊，他正和小安东尼奥待在一起。
请尽快把我写的这封信交给他！

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Hopefully, father hasn't
gone outside of the Rogue
Guild's panic room. That
may be the only place
where he's safe...
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
希望父亲没有离开流氓公会的密室。
那里可能是他唯一安全的地方...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
What's that? Father
wanted me to teach you
the secret Rogue skill?
Alright, I'll train you in the
same way father did. Would
you like an explanation first?
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
什么？父亲想让我教你流氓的秘技？
好吧，我会像父亲那样训练你。
你想先听一下说明吗？

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
If you don't want an
explanation, I'll just
send you to the training
ground right away so that
you can learn ^FF0000Close Confine^000000.
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
如果你不想听说明，我就直接送你去训练场，让你学习^FF0000紧密的约束^000000。

scripts.text: Listen to Explanation
scripts.translation: 听说明

scripts.text: Go to Training Ground
scripts.translation: 去训练场

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Alright, the very first step
to learning ^FF0000Close Confine^000000
is to master blocking your
enemy's movement. I'll send
you to a special training
ground so you can practice.
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
好的，学习^FF0000紧密的约束^000000的第一步是掌握阻挡敌人的移动。
我会送你去一个特殊的训练场让你练习。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
There, you'll encounter our
training partner. Approach her
closely and make sure that you
predict and block her movements
to the left, right or backward. Get ready, I'm sending you now...
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
在那里，你会遇到我们的训练搭档。靠近她，确保你能预判并阻挡她向左、向右或向后的移动。
准备好了，我现在就送你过去...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Alright, I'm going to break
the fourth wall here and assume
you were disconnected from the
game. Would you like to return
to the training ground in order
to learn ^FF0000Close Confine^000000?
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
好吧，我要打破第四面墙了，假设你刚才断线了。
你想回到训练场继续学习^FF0000紧密的约束^000000吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Alright, the very first step
to learning ^FF0000Close Confine^000000
is to master blocking your
enemy's movement. I'll send
you to a special training
ground so you can practice.
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
好的，学习^FF0000紧密的约束^000000的第一步是掌握阻挡敌人的移动。
我会送你去一个特殊的训练场让你练习。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
There, you'll encounter our
training partner. Approach her
closely and make sure that you
predict and block her movements
to the left, right or backward. Get ready, I'm sending you now...
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
在那里，你会遇到我们的训练搭档。靠近她，确保你能预判并阻挡她向左、向右或向后的移动。
准备好了，我现在就送你过去...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Alright, alright.
When you feel ready
to resume training,
just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
好的，好的。
当你准备好继续训练时，告诉我一声。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Ah, I hear from Kienna
that you've completed your
training. Congratulations!
Now, please speak to my
father so that he can explain the Close Confine skill in detail.
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
啊，我从基恩娜那里听说你完成了训练。恭喜！
现在，请去和我的父亲对话，让他详细解释紧密的约束这个技能。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Please talk to my father
so that he can explain the
nuances of the Close Confine
skill to you. He should still be in the Rogue Guild's panic room.
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
请和我的父亲对话，让他向你解释紧密的约束技能的细节。他应该还在流氓公会的密室里。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
You know, Chae Takbae
would say, ''I'm Chae
Takbae. And you are...?''
to opponents, and right
before they could answer,
he'd beat them to a pulp.
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
你知道吗，蔡德培会对对手说：
“我是蔡德培。而你是...？”
就在对方还没来得及回答之前，他就把对方打得落花流水。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
He really is
a legendary hero
amongst Rogues...!
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
他真的是流氓中的传奇英雄...！

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Hm...?
It seems that
you're much stronger
than even me. There's
probably not too many
people who'd mess with you...
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
嗯...？
看来你比我强多了。
大概没多少人敢招惹你...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Hmm, gank this, gank
that. *Sigh* It's my most
shameful fault: I spend zeny
almost as quickly as I can
steal it. It's irresponsible...
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
嗯，抢这个，抢那个。
*叹气* 这是我最大的耻辱：我花钱的速度几乎和偷窃的速度一样快。真是不负责任...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
My father must be hidden
in the Rogue Guild's panic
room. Strangely, my brothers
and I can never find it and
figure out whether he's safe...
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
父亲一定躲在流氓公会的密室里。
奇怪的是，我和兄弟们总是找不到它，也不知道他是否安全...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Recently, he's been pursued
by these strange men who've
been threatening our family.
Well, he did just teach us
a new skill, so he can use
that to protect himself...
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
最近，他一直被一些奇怪的男人追赶，他们威胁着我们的家族。
不过，他刚教了我们一个新技能，所以他应该能用来自保...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
I'm guessing my father
hid himself in the Rogue
Guild's panic room. We can
never find it, but supposedly
the entrance is hidden close
to Markie somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
我猜父亲是躲在流氓公会的密室里。
我们总是找不到它，但据说入口就在马基附近。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
You're looking for
Louis, my little brother?
He's here in the Rouge Guild,
so it shouldn't be too hard to
find him. He's probably just
standing near Hollgrehen Jr.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
你在找我弟弟路易斯？
他就在流氓公会里，应该不难找到。
他大概正站在小霍尔格雷恩附近。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Thor? He should be
around the Rogue Guild
somewhere. Have you tried
looking around Hermathorn Jr.?
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
索尔？他应该在流氓公会附近。
你试过在小赫曼索恩附近找找吗？

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
A letter for me...?
Ah, it's from Thor, so
I guess I better read
it right away. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
给我的信...？
啊，是索尔寄来的，看来我得马上读一下。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
I see... I must report
this to the Rogue Guild
right away, and send a reply
to my father. Hmm. Let me
write him a letter right now.
Please give me a moment...
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
我明白了...我必须立刻向流氓公会报告，并给父亲回信。嗯。让我现在就写。
请给我一点时间...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
There, it's done. Please
give this to my father with
all the haste you can muster.
I know it's much to ask, but
I cannot find the way to the
hidden panic room myself...
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
好了，写完了。请尽可能快地把这封信交给我的父亲。
我知道这要求有点过分，但我自己找不到通往密室的路...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Please give my reply
to my father as soon as
you can. He's still hidden
in the Rogue Guild's panic
room. That is, if our enemies
still haven't found him yet.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
请尽快把我的回信交给父亲。
他还躲在流氓公会的密室里。
也就是说，如果我们的敌人还没找到他的话。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
You need to train for
the Close Confine skill?
I think Thor is the only
one with access to the
training ground, so
talk to him first.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
你需要练习“紧密的约束”技能？
我想只有索尔有权限使用训练场，所以请先去和他谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
You need to train for
the Close Confine skill?
I think Thor is the only
one with access to the
training ground, so
talk to him first.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
你需要练习“紧密的约束”技能？
我想只有索尔有权限使用训练场，所以请先去和他谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Ah, you finished the
training for Close Confine,
did you? Great, now go and
tell my brother, Thor.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
啊，你已经完成了“紧密的约束”的练习？
很好，现在去告诉我弟弟索尔吧。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Hm. You should probably
talk to my father to learn
more of the nuances about
the Close Confine skill.
Have you seen him in the
Rogue Guild's panic room?
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
嗯。你最好和我父亲谈谈，了解更多关于“紧密的约束”的细节。
你在流氓公会的密室里见过他吗？

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Chae Takbae sure
seemed like a stubborn,
thuggish guy. But he must
have been pretty smart to
invent some of his own skills.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
蔡德培看起来确实是个固执、粗鲁的家伙。但他一定很聪明，才能发明出一些自己的技能。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
I get the feeling
that you're going to
be one of the best Rogues
around, if you already aren't.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
我感觉你将成为最厉害的流氓之一，如果你现在还不是的话。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Ever since I learned
Intimdate, I've gotten
real punchy, maybe even
masochistic. I mean, if they
hit you with a skill, you can
hit them back with it!
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
自从学会了“抄袭”，我就变得很有攻击性，甚至有点受虐倾向。
我是说，如果他们用技能打你，你也可以用同样的技能反击！

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, in this
exercise, you'll need
to predict which way I'm
going to move and block
me from moving, essentially
immobilizing me. Get ready~
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好了，在这个练习中，你需要预判我要往哪个方向移动，并阻止我移动，基本上就是让我无法动弹。准备好了~

scripts.text: Block her to the Left
scripts.translation: 向左阻挡

scripts.text: Block her to the Right
scripts.translation: 向右阻挡

scripts.text: Block her retreat
scripts.translation: 阻挡退路

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Huh...?
You blocked me!
Very nice work~
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
咦...？
你挡住我了！
做得非常好~

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Sorry, but I wasn't
moving in that direction.
Your block attempt failed...
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
抱歉，但我并没有往那个方向移动。
你的阻挡失败了...

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好了，我们在这里的训练结束了。
你获得了一个

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
training grade of ''^0000FFS^000000.''
That's a perfect score!
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好了，我们在这里的训练结束了。
你获得了“^0000FFS^000000”的训练成绩。
这是满分哦！

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
training grade of ''^0000FFA^000000.''
You're really good at this!
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好了，我们在这里的训练结束了。
你获得了“^0000FFA^000000”的训练成绩。
你真的很擅长这个！

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
training grade of ''^0000FFB +^000000.''
That's very commendable!
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好了，我们在这里的训练结束了。
你获得了“^0000FFB +^000000”的训练成绩。
非常值得称赞！

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
training grade of ''^0000FFB^000000.''
That's very nice work~
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好了，我们在这里的训练结束了。
你获得了“^0000FFB^000000”的训练成绩。
